description: This file defines the SearchQuerySelectDelegate class, which extends functionality for building search queries in Hibernate Search, specifically allowing the setting and handling of a final predicate for search filtering within the OpenMRS project. It serves as an internal component for constructing complex search queries with customizable predicates.

classes.name: SearchQuerySelectDelegate
classes.description: A delegate class extending search query capabilities to include setting a final predicate for filtering and customizing search steps within Hibernate Search in the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: setFinalPredicate
methods.description: Sets the final predicate function used to augment search predicates.

methods.name: getFinalPredicate
methods.description: Retrieves the currently set final predicate function.

methods.name: where
methods.description: Overrides the 'where' method to add the final predicate to the search query options.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Overrides various 'select' methods to provide search steps that incorporate the final predicate, via delegation.

methods.name: selectEntity
methods.description: Delegates selection of entity within the search query, including the final predicate.

methods.name: select(SearchProjection<?>... projections)
methods.description: Selects projections with the inclusion of the final predicate.

methods.name:
select(Function, ? extends ProjectionFinalStep

> projectionContributor)
methods.description: Allows custom projection selection augmented with the final predicate.

methods.name: selectEntityReference
methods.description: Selects entity references with the final predicate applied.

methods.name:
select(SearchProjection

projection)
methods.description: Selects a specific projection, incorporating the final predicate.
